name: digital-twin
description: Mine your own Claude Code session logs to build a portable profile and behavioral twin sub-agent that captures how you actually work. Produces PROFILE.md, PROFILE.html, twin.md, generated CLAUDE rules, and a CLAUDE.md install guide. Local analysis stays local; LLM-bound extraction uses your existing Claude Code auth for deep reads, profile insights, and the behavioral twin spec. No plugin telemetry.
